plateau.note: City slab: level with the park (y 0), no wall or stairs.

lagoon_street.note: Runs right against the boulevard: its park_sidewalk (z -76.8..-74.33) is this street's north sidewalk. z bands are [north, south]. x -120..120: island rim to rim (the outskirts band continues both streets); the tree clearing (clearings.json) keeps trees off it.

bridges.note: Footbridges over both streets (north_city.mjs buildBridges): deck_y is the walking surface; stairs go east onto the verge from south_z and east along the tower pavement from the deck's east side; the pier stands on the shared sidewalk (z -76.8..-74.33). Lamps, tree pits, bikes and cafes keep clear of them.

traffic.note: Driving cars (StreetCars.gd): per_lane cars in each of the 4 lanes (eastbound on the south half of each road, westbound on the north half), looping over x with the road's flat run in the outskirts band (outskirts.json ground.shelf_len).
